title: Health & Social Care Diploma (Level 3–5)
subject: Health & Social Care
summary: A flexible route into health and care careers, with progression to a degree.
description: Start at Level 3 to learn the basics of care, then progress to Level 4 (HNC) and Level 5 (HND).
After Level 5 you can complete a one-year top-up degree in health and social care.
entryRequirements: Level 3: usually no formal qualifications needed, just a good level of English
Level 4 and 5: a Level 3 qualification or the previous level
